inputs.text: Health workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations protested at Unity Fountain in Maitama, Abuja, on Thursday over reform bills before the National Assembly. Their concerns deserve to be heard, but organised unions should not be allowed to block changes simply to defend their own position. Elected lawmakers—not pressure groups—must weigh the competing interests and decide what serves patients and families. A system that preserves the status quo at all costs is not necessarily protecting the public. Judge these bills by whether they strengthen healthcare for ordinary people, not by whether every union approves.
